scripts.build:mcp: bun build mcp/server.ts --target node --format esm --minify --outfile mcp/dist/server.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p mcp && sh -c 'if [ -d .claude-plugin/types/claude-code ]; then tsc -p .; else echo "typecheck: salteo hooks/ y tests/: faltan los tipos de Claude Code en .claude-plugin/types (los escribe claude --plugin-dir .)" >&2; fi'
scripts.test:mcp: bun run build:mcp && bun run typecheck && bun test mcp/
scripts.test: bun run test:mcp && claude plugin test . && sh tests/find-chrome.sh && sh tests/guard-branch.sh && sh tests/session-context.sh
